question: How many players were born after the year 1985?
sql: SELECT graph.Player_Id FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('soccer_2016', 'MATCH (player:Player) WHERE substring(player.DOB, 1, 4) > 1985 RETURN count(player.Player_Id)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(Player_Id INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph

sql: SELECT graph.Venue_name FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('soccer_2016', 'MATCH (t1:Venue)<-[t2:City]-(t3:Country) WHERE (t3.country_name = ''South Africa'' AND t2.city_name = ''Centurion'') RETURN count(t1.Venue_name)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(Venue_name INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('soccer_2016', 'MATCH (t1:Venue)<-[t2:City]-(t3:Country) WHERE (t3.country_name = ''South Africa'' AND t2.city_name = ''Centurion'') RETURN count(t1.Venue_name)')

question: What is the difference between the number of matches where SC Ganguly played as a Captain and those matches where he played other roles?
sql: SELECT graph.sumCASE FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('soccer_2016', 'MATCH (t1:Player_Match)<-[t2:Player]-(t3:Rolee) WHERE t2.Player_Name = ''SC Ganguly'' RETURN (sum(CASE WHEN t3.Role_Id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN t3.Role_Id > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(sumCASE INT PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('soccer_2016', 'MATCH (t1:Player_Match)<-[t2:Player]-(t3:Rolee) WHERE t2.Player_Name = ''SC Ganguly'' RETURN (sum(CASE WHEN t3.Role_Id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN t3.Role_Id > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))')
